findings.location: HTML paragraph beginning “There was a modern church that caught my attention.”
findings.source_quote: “They seemed to be on fire for the Lord!”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Walionekana kumwaka kwa ajili ya Bwana!” with “Walionekana kuwaka moto kwa ajili ya Bwana!”

findings.location: HTML paragraph beginning “As I was standing in line at a fast-food restaurant”
findings.source_quote: “He got sober and explained that he wanted to believe in God but couldn’t.”
findings.suggested_fix: Use “Alitulia na kueleza...” or “Akawa na uzito wa mawazo, kisha akaeleza...” to convey that he became serious or sober in demeanor.
findings.translation_quote: “Akawa mtulivu na kueleza kwamba alitaka kumwamini Mungu lakini hakuweza.”
